The public website previously offered Spanish on five canonical pages; other public routes fell back to English. This candidate supplies real Spanish owners for all 42 canonical public pages, reciprocal metadata and sitemap entries, document language navigation, translated footer/adoption controls, and Spanish summaries for the unchanged 26-operation API contract. The 1,108-message catalogue includes diagram captions and accessible labels and preserves reviewed translations by message ID.

Unpublished legal/company content remains a publication-under-review notice. Account controls, the consent controls and existing English PDF are explicitly identified as English. Technical disclosures retain their content and open hash-targeted sections. Public buttons wrap longer translated labels on mobile. The existing locale routing and Turnstile action-binding fixes are retained.

This PR contains website changes only. Approval-enforcement application and SQL work remain separate PRs #131 and #132. No cloud binding update, hosted synthetic write, migration application or Production promotion is included. `docs/PREVIEW-STAGING-BINDINGS.json` is a preparation manifest only. Existing translation and TENENTE worktrees are preserved.

Validation at head `13a3485bb8a6ec8af720ec579bcf6b357003dec6`: all reported CI checks passed, including verify (audit/lint/typecheck/full tests/build), CodeQL, gitleaks, Docker qualification and the dedicated immutable-head browser workflow. Browser CI independently passed 84 HTTP routes, 168 rendering checks at asserted 390px/1440px widths, 114 link targets and four navigation/form checks with zero JavaScript/public asset errors. The final application-source local build passed. Twenty locale/catalogue/metadata/API presentation regressions passed. Protected workflow 503s and the unbound consent endpoint's 403 remain recorded as blockers, not successful backend tests. Supabase Preview was skipped; it does not establish hosted database qualification.

Preview `dpl_EbJKhGVBZK3r76qxHcxAeXh4Sa9S` is READY at that exact head. Authenticated read-only GETs passed for Home, Spanish Home/Pricing/Platform/Help/Contact/Privacy, each with HTTP200, expected document language and real page content. This is public rendering evidence only.

Hosted positive Turnstile, direct Supabase CAPTCHA enforcement, Auth/consent persistence, private settings and provider execution remain unqualified. Staging is ACTIVE_HEALTHY, but the two new approval/dispatch RPCs are absent. Branch-specific Preview bindings, named migration application after drift reconciliation, and controlled synthetic writes require separate approvals. Production promotion approval is absent. Do not infer hosted readiness from a green build or local public rendering.
